description: This file defines the interface for rbus buffer management, including buffer creation, destruction, reading, writing, and encoding/decoding functions for various data types, used within the rbus messaging system.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Create
methods.description: Initializes a new rbusBuffer instance.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Destroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an rbusBuffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Reserve
methods.description: Reserves additional space in the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Write
methods.description: Writes raw data into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteTypeLengthValue
methods.description: Writes a TLV (Type-Length-Value) formatted data into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteBooleanTLV
methods.description: Writes a boolean value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteCharTLV
methods.description: Writes a char value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteByteTLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned byte as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt8TLV
methods.description: Writes an int8 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt8TLV
methods.description: Writes a uint8 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt16TLV
methods.description: Writes an int16 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt16TLV
methods.description: Writes a uint16 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt32TLV
methods.description: Writes an int32 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt32TLV
methods.description: Writes a uint32 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt64TLV
methods.description: Writes an int64 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt64TLV
methods.description: Writes a uint64 value as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteSingleTLV
methods.description: Writes a float (single precision) as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteDoubleTLV
methods.description: Writes a double (double precision float) as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteStringTLV
methods.description: Writes a string as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteDateTimeTLV
methods.description: Writes a rbusDateTime_t as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteBytesTLV
methods.description: Writes raw bytes as TLV.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Read
methods.description: Reads raw data from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadBoolean
methods.description: Reads a boolean value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadChar
methods.description: Reads a char value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadByte
methods.description: Reads an unsigned byte from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt8
methods.description: Reads an int8 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt8
methods.description: Reads a uint8 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt16
methods.description: Reads an int16 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a uint16 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt32
methods.description: Reads an int32 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a uint32 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads an int64 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a uint64 value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadSingle
methods.description: Reads a float (single precision) from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadDouble
methods.description: Reads a double (double precision float) from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadString
methods.description: Reads a string from the buffer; caller must free the string.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadDateTime
methods.description: Reads a rbusDateTime_t from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads raw bytes from the buffer; caller must free the bytes.
